_comment: Untyped-wire-type allowlist for check-protocol-ts-lockstep.mjs. Each entry is a canonical Harbor Protocol wire type (singlesource.CanonicalWireTypes) that the hand-maintained Console TypeScript client intentionally does NOT declare as a named interface/type today — request bodies the Console builds inline as generic-namespace params, responses narrowed inline at the call site, and runtime/meta shapes the Console renders without a named type. The lockstep guard requires every untyped canonical type to appear here with a justification; a NEW Go wire type that lands without a TS interface fails the guard until it is either typed or consciously added here. Stale entries (a type now typed in TS, or no longer canonical) also fail the guard. This file is HAND-MAINTAINED.
